findings.problem: Explanation says slow hashes make guessing millions of candidates impractical.
findings.evidence: bcrypt/Argon2id raise the cost per guess, but a GPU rig still tries millions of candidates against one hash in hours; weak passwords still fall. The point is cost per guess, not impossibility.
findings.old: make guessing millions of candidates impractical
findings.new: make every guess slow and costly, so trying millions of candidates takes far longer
